introduction: The following special conditions apply specifically to this project and supplement the standard terms.

terms.title: Limitation Of Noble Architecture's Appointment
terms.content: It is explicitly agreed that Noble Architecture's scope of services concludes at submission of the Permitted Development application, unless the quotation and written appointment explicitly include "Design Phase 03 – Building Regulations Compliance" (or equivalent wording confirming a Building Regulations technical design stage). No such stage is included within the current appointment.

terms.title: Transfer Of Technical Responsibility After Permitted Development
terms.content: The Client has confirmed that Sukhi Home Solutions will assume responsibility for all technical aspects, construction methods, coordination of technical design, and Building Regulations compliance immediately following the Permitted Development phase. Drawings produced by Noble Architecture are illustrative concept and permitted development documents only, and must not be relied upon for fabrication, procurement, setting-out or construction.

terms.title: Principal Designer (Building Regulations Dutyholder) Transfer
terms.content: In accordance with the Building Safety Act 2022 and the Building Regulations etc. (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2023, the statutory role of "Principal Designer" for Building Regulations compliance is phase-specific and attaches only to the party in control of the design work for the relevant phase. Unless Noble Architecture is specifically retained in writing for the Building Regulations technical phase, Noble Architecture's statutory role as Principal Designer automatically concludes upon submission of the Permitted Development application. Where the Domestic Client does not formally appoint a replacement Principal Designer in writing, the Principal Designer role transfers to the person or organisation in control of the building work, being Sukhi Home Solutions for this project unless otherwise appointed.

terms.title: Building Control Application Is Separate And Not Included
terms.content: A Certificate of Lawful Development confirms only that the works do not require planning permission. It carries no Building Regulations approval whatsoever. A separate Building Control application, whether by Full Plans or by Building Notice, is required and must be made before works commence on site. That application, its fees, all associated inspections and all technical submissions are the responsibility of Sukhi Home Solutions and are not included within Noble Architecture's appointment or fees.

terms.title: Structural Engineers & Independent Verification
terms.content: Sukhi Home Solutions must appoint and utilise their own independent Structural Engineers. Structural design of the new opening formed into the existing rear wall of the bungalow, of all beams, lintels and foundations, and of the flat roof structure, sits entirely outside Noble Architecture's appointment. Any documentation, drawings or three dimensional models provided by Noble Architecture do not constitute a measured building survey or a structural design. All appointed engineers and specialists must undertake their own site surveys and verify all key dimensions.

terms.title: Flat Warm Roof & EPDM Specification
terms.content: During the telephone consultation an insulated flat warm roof finished in EPDM single ply membrane, incorporating flat roof lights, was discussed and agreed as the intended form of construction. This is a high level conceptual description of the intended build up and does not constitute a technical specification. The insulation type and thickness, thermal performance and U-value compliance, deck construction, falls, drainage, upstands, membrane detailing and roof light specification are all matters for Sukhi Home Solutions or the appointed technical designer for the Building Regulations stage.

terms.title: Drainage And Existing Services
terms.content: No survey of the existing below ground drainage has been undertaken by Noble Architecture, and the position of existing drain runs, inspection chambers and services beneath or adjacent to the proposed extension is not known. Investigation of the existing drainage, any diversion or relocation works, and any Build Over Agreement required with the statutory undertaker are the responsibility of Sukhi Home Solutions and are not included within Noble Architecture's appointment.

terms.title: Demolition Of The Existing Conservatory & Reuse Of Existing Structure
terms.content: Demolition of the existing garden room conservatory, the making good of the existing rear elevation, and the assessment and adequacy of any existing foundation, slab or structure that is retained or built upon are entirely the responsibility of Sukhi Home Solutions. Noble Architecture has not inspected the existing conservatory or its foundations and gives no opinion as to whether any part of the existing structure is suitable for reuse.

terms.title: Re-Engagement Of Noble Architecture For A Technical Package
terms.content: If the Client or Contractor later requires a Building Regulations technical design package, including detailed cross-sections, thermal details and pre-approval submissions, this is a new instruction. It will be subject to a fresh quotation, quotations are valid for 30 days, and the Client acknowledges that Noble Architecture typically requires a minimum lead time of 6 weeks before commencing new technical drawing work. The Client must factor this into the construction programme to avoid delays.
